label: Форма
description: A 10-sentence usage card for форма (form; uniform).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Форма' is the feminine nominative subject of the possession frame 'у этого стола'. 'Необычная' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Форму' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'надевает', here meaning a uniform. 'Каждое утро' marks the routine.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quality. 'Формы' is the genitive describing the shape of the cloud. 'Странной' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'облако' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Форме' is the prepositional after 'в', describing what they wear. 'Одинаковой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Prepositional idiom. 'Форме' is the prepositional after 'в' in the idiom 'в хорошей форме', meaning in good shape. 'Хорошей' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a short adjective. 'Формой' is the instrumental required by 'довольна', meaning pleased with. 'Нового платья' is the genitive of possession.

missions.phrase: Без формы охранника не пускают внутрь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after 'без'. 'Формы' is the genitive after 'без', meaning without the uniform. 'Охранника' is the accusative animate object.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Формы' is the accusative plural object of 'изучаем', here meaning grammatical forms. 'Глаголов' is the genitive plural specifying which forms.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Формы' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'разных размеров' is the genitive of quality.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Форму' is the accusative after 'в', here a baking mould into which the dough is poured. 'Круглую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
